detail.title: Dedicated schools grant (DSG): @year1 to @year2 financial year allocations
This file gives details of the @year1 to @year2 financial year allocations of the DSG. Please note that Isles of Scilly and City of London are not included within this file.
This spreadsheet contains the following worksheets:
This worksheet contains summary information on total DSG allocations for financial year @year1 to @year2 for each local authority in England.

This worksheet contains the calculations carried out to derive the @year1 to @year2 financial year schools block and central school services block (CSSB) allocations to each local authority. More information on the derivation of schools block and CSSB pupil counts used in the calculation can be found in the @year1 to @year2 DSG pupil number tool on the GOV.UK website.
This worksheet shows how the provisional high needs block, before the import/export adjustment and deductions in @year1 to @year2 financial year, has been derived.

This worksheet shows: (i) the number of high needs places in academic year @year0 to @year1 and @year1 to @year2 reported by local authorities; (ii) the deductions made to @year1 to @year2 financial year high needs block allocations for high needs places in recoupment academies, special and AP academies, Further Education (FE) and Independent Learning Providers (ILPs): place funding is instead provided to these institutions directly by the Department for Education.

This worksheet contains the calculations carried out to derive the @year1 to @year2 financial year early years block allocations to each local authority. More information on the derivation of early years block pupil counts used in the calculation can be found in the @year1 to @year2 DSG pupil number tool on the GOV.UK website. Part time equivalent pupil counts have been multilpied by 15 hours and 38 weeks to arrive at the total funded hours.
Academic year @year0 to @year1 and @year1 to @year2 high needs places have updated.
